Ambiguity is a semantic relation whereby a grammatical expression can have more than one interpretation.
______ is the smallest meaningful grammatical unit.
morpheme
The morpheme is the smallest meaningful grammatical unit.
______ is a sequence of two vowel sounds while a triphthong is a sequence of three vowels, and they are produced by gliding from one vowel to the other.
diphthong
A diphthong is a sequence of two vowel sounds while a triphthong is a sequence of three vowels, and they are produced by gliding from one vowel to the other.
______ is the basic unit of phonological study.
phoneme
The phoneme is the basic unit of phonological study.
______ is a phonological feature in which all vowels within a defined unit agree in one phonetic value.
Vowel harmony
Vowel harmony is a phonological feature in which all vowels within a defined unit agree in one phonetic value.
